P7679.corridor_notes: GEM row = Heshan Branch of the Guangxi Gas Branch Pipeline Network (广西天然气支线管网项目合山天然气支线管道工程), operator Guangxi Gas Group (广西广投天然气管网有限公司); Xingbin District -> Heshan City, ~33km, proposed. The pilot (prior) pass located two 2019 government filings that independently name this exact project -- a Guangxi Dept. of Natural Resources land-use pre-review (dnr.gxzf.gov.cn t16421841, doc 桂自然资预审〔2019〕49号, dated 2019-07-24) and a Guangxi DRC core-approval (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t10409864, ~2019-09-27, investment RMB 128.02M -- an exact match to GEM's SegmentCost) -- confirming existence and general corridor (Xingbin to Heshan), but neither document names a specific 分输站 (distribution station) or township along the route. This session re-attempted both live and via Wayback Machine; neither was reachable (see blockers). No alternate publication naming a finer point was found before this session's WebSearch budget was exhausted.
P7679.researcher_notes: Existence of this exact branch is independently corroborated (2019 land-use pre-review + DRC core-approval, investment figure exact match to GEM) even though neither underlying document could be re-fetched this session. Per the pilot's separate status_review (out of scope for this route-creation task), this branch shows no independently-dated activity after 2019 -- 7 years dormant vs. sibling branches on the same program (e.g. Qianjiang) that show 2025 activity -- a 'shelved' status recommendation is already logged elsewhere.
P7679.blockers: No verifiable ([ref]-passable) URL was found for either endpoint at station or township granularity, matching the outcome anticipated in this task's SPECIAL NOTES. The two known primary documents (dnr.gxzf.gov.cn t16421841; fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t10409864) are on the gxzf.gov.cn domain family, which ConnectTimeouts/ECONNREFUSEDs from this environment on every attempt (curl and WebFetch). Wayback Machine (archive.org) lookups for these two URLs returned persistent HTTP 429 (rate-limited) throughout this session, likely from concurrent sibling agents sharing this sandbox's egress IP -- could not obtain an archived snapshot either. Coordinates given are county/city-level Nominatim centroids only, not a sourced pipeline endpoint or station.

P7690.corridor_notes: GEM row = Laibin Branch, Xingbin-Wuxuan Segment (广西天然气支线管网项目来宾天然气支线管道工程（兴宾-武宣段）), operator Guangxi Gas Group, under construction. Sina News (k.sina.com.cn, 2022-12-20, verified) reports the groundbreaking ceremony for the wider Laibin branch (来宾天然气支线管道工程暨三江口新区天然气管道项目) took place at Liumian village (刘冕村), Chengxiang town (城厢镇), Xingbin District, on National Highway 314 -- village-level precision, but Liumian village itself did not resolve in Nominatim, so the town centroid is used as the plotted start point. The same article describes the overall Laibin-branch route as Laibin distribution station -> Xingbin -> Wuxuan -> Xiangzhou -> Jinxiu, pipe OD 273.1mm, 4.0MPa design pressure. Laibin Daily (epaper.lbnews.com.cn, 2023-08-09, verified) separately confirms the EIA for this EXACT sub-segment (兴宾-武宣段) was completed and open for public comment, developer Guangxi Gas Group -- confirming the segment terminates in Wuxuan County, but without naming a specific Wuxuan-side station or township. A separate 2019-era dnr.gxzf.gov.cn land-use approval (t19512609, unreachable/unverified this session) additionally names Nansi Township (南泗乡) and Mengcun Town (蒙村镇) within Xingbin District as land crossed by the '兴宾段' (Xingbin portion) of this same project -- consistent context, not used as a cited ref since the page itself is unreachable.
P7690.researcher_notes: Pilot pass already flagged a Diameter spec concern (GEM records a bare 250mm while every independent source gives 273.1mm OD) -- out of scope for this route-creation task, noted for the parallel validity-fix workstream. The groundbreaking-ceremony location (Chengxiang town) is a reasonable proxy for a route start point but is not itself confirmed as the literal pipeline terminus/station -- flagging as a caveat for the human router.
P7690.blockers: Wuxuan-side endpoint is sourced only to county granularity -- no station/township-level document was found or reachable this session (the analogous dnr.gxzf.gov.cn land-use filing for the '武宣段' portion, mirroring the Xingbin-side t19512609 filing, was not located before the WebSearch budget was exhausted).

P7678.corridor_notes: GEM row = Pingnan Branch (广西天然气支线管网项目平南天然气支线管道工程), operator Guangxi Gas Group, GEM Status=cancelled/CancelledYear=2024 (pilot pass found this contradicted by the row's own cited ref, which actually reads as a 2020 approval-extension, not a cancellation notice -- separate status_review finding, out of scope here). gigeps.com (verified; a project-information portal republishing the EIA route description) gives a precise route: starts at Guiping distribution station in Mengwei/Mengxu Town (蒙圩镇), Guiping City; runs ~5.7km east crossing the Xiajiang River to valve station #17; ~9.6km further east (parallel to the existing West-2nd-Line Nanning branch) crossing the Yujiang River to the Shesbu valve station; ~14.2km further crossing the Guiwa Expressway and Nanguang high-speed rail; ~8km northeast to the Shespo valve station; then enters Pingnan County through Mule Township and terminates at Pingnan Distribution Station in Zhuangzhai Village (庄寨村), Zhenlong Town (镇隆镇). Total ~58km per this source (55.3km Guiping + 2.7km Pingnan) vs. GEM's 63.00km -- broadly consistent (treated as a rounding/methodology difference, not a contradiction).
P7678.researcher_notes: Endpoint place names (Mengwei/Mengxu Town start; Zhuangzhai Village/Zhenlong Town end) are the most precise found -- village-level for the end point per the source prose -- but Nominatim could not resolve either specific village, so town-level centroids stand in as the plotted coordinates. A human router could refine geometry further using the valve-station chain (17# valve station, Shesbu valve station, Shespo valve station, Mule Township) described in corridor_notes if finer intermediate waypoints are wanted. Two spellings appear for the start town across sources ('蒙圩镇' in government-filing titles vs. 'Mengwei' in the gigeps.com English-rendered summary) -- same place, 蒙圩镇/Mengxu Town, Guiping.

P7689.corridor_notes: GEM row = Daren-Nandan Branch ('大任—南丹天然气支线项目'), operator Guangxi Gas Group, proposed. The pilot pass retrieved the actual government line-item via Wayback Machine (fgw.gxzf.gov.cn t16217273.shtml notice + its Attachment-5 investment-plan xlsx, snapshotted 2025-04-13): ~97km new-build transmission pipeline, DN300, 4.0MPa, RMB 425M investment, owner Guangxi Gas Group -- an exact match to GEM's specs. That same source table lists '项目管理层级' (jurisdiction/management level) as Hechi City (河池市), not Laibin as GEM's sheet currently records (see the pilot's separate attribution concern -- out of scope for this route-creation task, but the geocoding in this file follows Hechi, not Laibin, per that finding). 163.com (2023-04-06, verified this session) independently reports the same DRC notice and explicitly groups this project ('大任—南丹天然气支线项目') among Hechi City's slate of energy projects, alongside the Jinchengjiang power project -- corroborating the Hechi attribution and confirming Nandan as the terminus. Neither source pins 'Daren' to a specific township within Hechi (it is presumed to be 市大任产业园, a city-level industrial park, but its exact location was not found this session) -- Jinchengjiang District, Hechi's main urban district, is used only as a coordinate proxy.
P7689.researcher_notes: Pilot pass already flagged that StartPrefecture/District and EndPrefecture/District should be corrected from 'Laibin' to 'Hechi' (河池市), and that ProposalMonth (12) is likely a mis-copy of a construction-start-month field rather than the true proposal date -- both out of scope for this route-creation task, noted here for the parallel validity-fix workstream. Start-point precision is the main open gap for route creation: 'Daren' as a named place could not be independently pinned to a township/village this session.
P7689.blockers: Daren Industrial Park's precise location within Hechi City is not independently sourced -- the start coordinate is a Jinchengjiang-District-level proxy, not a geocoded hit on 'Daren' itself. The Wayback xlsx attachment (route-level table) intermittently fails to load (ConnectionError on repeat attempts, though it returned HTTP 200 at least once this session and was opened directly with openpyxl during the pilot pass) -- treat as flaky-but-real, a known binary-file false-negative pattern for url_verifier, not evidence the page is dead.

P7662.corridor_notes: GEM row = Guilin-Yangshuo-Lipu Branch, officially '广西天然气支线管网项目桂林—阳朔—荔浦天然气支线管道工程' per the row's own (unreachable) fgw.gxzf.gov.cn ref (t2198137), later also referred to as '桂东北天然气环网桂林-阳朔-荔浦段' (Northeast-Guilin gas ring network) in 2022-2023 government/press coverage -- same physical route, developer PipeChina Southwest Oil & Gas Pipeline Co., Nanning Branch. Guangxi Daily (epaper.gxrb.com.cn, 2021-11-15, verified) EIA public-comment notice names Shanggaoqiao Village (上高桥村) and Xiazhuang among affected villages within Guilin, and gives the construction company as the PipeChina Southwest Nanning branch -- consistent with a Linggui District start. General (non-single-URL) reporting breaks the ~100km route down as ~50km in Linggui District, ~32km in Yangshuo County, ~18km in Lipu; GEM's own EndLocation=Lipu with StartLocation left null in the sheet, so Linggui is used as the plotted start here on the strength of the Guangxi Daily notice's Guilin-area village names plus that county-level breakdown. Liuzhou Investment Promotion Bureau's republication of a Guangxi Daily energy-project roundup (tzcjj.liuzhou.gov.cn, 2023-04-07, verified) independently confirms the ring-network project as one of 11 'continuing construction' (续建) oil/gas projects in Guangxi's 2023 plan -- corroborates the pilot's status_review finding that this project is past 'proposed' by 2023 (a status-staleness item, out of scope here), not a route detail.
P7662.researcher_notes: GEM's own StartLocation cell is null for this row -- Linggui District is inferred here from independent sourcing (Guangxi Daily's affected-village list + a general county-level length breakdown), not copied from GEM. Recommend a human reviewer confirm Linggui (临桂, not the similarly-named neighboring Lingchuan/灵川) before finalizing -- Linggui is the district explicitly named in the length breakdown and matches the 临政函〔2019〕9号 Lingui District government route/valve-chamber approval referenced in search results (unreachable to verify directly this session, cited only as directional corroboration, not a formal ref in this file).
